entities.name: Web3D Consortium
entities.note: Non-profit organization that develops and maintains the X3D standard.

entities.name: Naval Postgraduate School
entities.note: US Navy university hosting the Web3D Consortium's open-source X3D-Edit tool and extensive X3D archives.

entities.name: Fraunhofer IGD
entities.note: German research institute where X3DOM was originally developed.

entities.name: Virginia Tech
entities.note: University whose Center for Human-Computer Interaction is heavily involved in Web3D.

entities.name: Web3D Korea Chapter
entities.note: Regional chapter of the Web3D Consortium promoting X3D in Korea.

entities.name: ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 24
entities.note: ISO subcommittee responsible for computer graphics and image processing standards, including X3D.

entities.name: Khronos Group
entities.note: Standardization consortium that collaborates with Web3D on glTF and WebGL integration.

entities.name: OGC
entities.note: Open Geospatial Consortium, which collaborates with Web3D on geospatial 3D standards.

entities.name: Daly Realism
entities.note: Consulting company led by Leonard Daly, active in Web3D standards.

entities.name: Intelligraphics
entities.note: Company led by Richard Puk, heavily involved in editing X3D specifications.

entities.name: Don Brutzman
entities.note: Co-chair of the Web3D Consortium and researcher at the Naval Postgraduate School.

entities.name: Nicholas Polys
entities.note: President of the Web3D Consortium and researcher at Virginia Tech.

entities.name: Anita Havele
entities.note: Executive Director of the Web3D Consortium.

entities.name: Richard Puk
entities.note: Long-time specification editor for the Web3D Consortium.

entities.name: Johannes Behr
entities.note: Original creator of X3DOM and researcher at Fraunhofer IGD.

entities.name: Roy Walmsley
entities.note: Key specification editor and contributor to the X3D standard.

entities.name: Vince Marchetti
entities.note: Active Web3D Consortium member involved in CAD and 3D printing working groups.

entities.name: Leonard Daly
entities.note: Co-author of X3D books and active Web3D Consortium member.

entities.name: Myeong Won Lee
entities.note: Key representative of the Web3D Korea Chapter and professor.

entities.name: Michalis Kamburelis
entities.note: Creator of the Castle Game Engine and active Web3D Consortium member.

entities.name: Andreas Plesch
entities.note: Active contributor to X3DOM and X3D standards.

entities.name: Tony Parisi
entities.note: Co-creator of VRML, the predecessor to X3D.

entities.name: Mark Pesce
entities.note: Co-creator of VRML.

entities.name: John Carlson
entities.note: Active contributor to X3D JSON encoding and community tools.

entities.name: X3D 4.0
entities.note: The latest major version of the Extensible 3D standard.

entities.name: VRML
entities.note: Virtual Reality Modeling Language, the predecessor to X3D.

entities.name: X3D Working Group
entities.note: Primary working group within the Web3D Consortium developing the X3D standard.

entities.name: Medical Working Group
entities.note: Web3D working group focused on medical applications of X3D.

entities.name: Cultural Heritage Working Group
entities.note: Web3D working group focused on preserving cultural heritage using X3D.

entities.name: Web3D Conference
entities.note: Annual international conference on 3D web technology sponsored by ACM SIGGRAPH and Web3D Consortium.

entities.name: SIGGRAPH
entities.note: Special Interest Group on Computer Graphics and Interactive Techniques, which often co-locates with the Web3D Conference.

entities.name: X3DOM
entities.note: Open-source JavaScript framework for integrating X3D into HTML5.

entities.name: Castle Game Engine
entities.note: Open-source 3D and 2D game engine supporting X3D.

entities.name: X3D-Edit
entities.note: Open-source authoring tool for X3D scenes developed at NPS.
